Hyatt Regency Bangkok Sukhumvit   

Book a stay of at least 2 consecutive nights at Hyatt Regency Bangkok Sukhumvit during your trip to Bangkok and enjoy a special offer with your Studio Liberty Visa Platinum card.

The offer includes a complimentary one-way limousine transfer, breakfast for two, and a one-time authentic Thai dinner for two.

How to Redeem the Offer:

• Visit the Visa Destinations offer page and click “Unlock”

• Go to the partner’s official website and book a stay of at least 2 nights

• Mention that you are using the Visa offer during the booking process

• Pay with your Studio Liberty Visa Platinum card

Offer Terms:

• The offer is valid for bookings of at least 2 consecutive nights

• The offer is subject to availability

• Additional restrictions may apply on certain dates

• Cancellation and prepayment policies depend on the rate selected at the time of booking

• The offer is valid until December 31, 2026
